title: Turn-start capture test seam: make the wall-delay test a direct budget-policy assertion, and unit-test the production budget arithmetic and zero-wait overrun
outcome:
Two test-quality follow-ups to the cfg(test) turn-start capture clock in src/engram_turn_observations.rs.
(1) source_observation_audit_fixture_holds_when_real_time_passes_the_capture_deadline guards the test-mode budget policy, failing if that budget ever reads the deadline or the wall clock again. It does not simulate load. Rename it, or replace it with a direct assertion that engram_turn_start_capture_budget(stale deadline) == TEST_PHASE_DEADLOCK_GUARD, or drop WallDelayed.
(2) No test exercises the production budget arithmetic (deadline.saturating_duration_since(now), shared by the cleanup flush and the capture), and the armed Expired path skips engram_source_basis_within entirely. Move the arithmetic into a pure remaining(deadline, now) helper with a unit test, and optionally add an Expired variant that goes through engram_source_basis_within with Duration::ZERO, so the zero-wait overrun is covered.
acceptance: Turn-start capture test seam: make the wall-delay test a direct budget-policy assertion, and unit-test the production budget arithmetic and zero-wait overrun is done
